map.为什么按百公里油耗而不是仪表显示？: Why use consumption per 100 km rather than the dashboard reading?
map.仪表显示油耗常为近期工况值，且部分车型偏乐观；用长期记录的“加油量 ÷ 行驶里程: The dashboard figure often reflects recent conditions and is optimistic on some models; consumption per 100 km from a long-term record of "fuel added ÷ mileage ×100" is closer to reality, so cost estimates are more accurate.
map.每公里成本能代表全部用车成本吗？: Does cost per km represent total vehicle cost?
map.不能。它只含燃油，未计折旧、保险、保养、停车与过路费；完整用车成本通常是油费的: No. It only covers fuel and excludes depreciation, insurance, maintenance, parking and tolls; total vehicle cost is typically 2~3× the fuel cost, which must be added separately when comparing purchase or travel options.
